cases.method: One initial level/reference-equipment+3 fixture at the real spawn, no subsequent resource or monster reset; XP x1. Three actual potions bought before route. Ten real fights; ranged classes move only after server release. Actual return, authorized merchant sale, potion buy/use, full recovery and restock to at least the starting three bottles. Startup stock capital is reported separately from actual repeat-route replenishment spending; no hypothetical healing charges.
